migrations.rlsAndGrants: Five private RLS tables without application grants. Three narrowly scoped service-only RPCs use explicit empty search paths.
migrations.authorization: Live actor and session, recent TOTP, assigned founder authority, consent, approved receipt, policy and conflict are checked before grant.
migrations.compatibility: Independent review, bootstrap records, discovery, project and poll permissions are unchanged. The profile designation is an optional additive field.
migrations.validation: Disposable Chromium and SQL cover direct permissions, scope, expired and revoked sessions, concurrent state changes, receipts and public display.
migrations.rolloutAndRollback: No hosted write. Apply the ordered O2 and O3 sequence only after separate authorization. Preserve history and use a forward policy closure or recovery migration.
